caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow bowl or plate with a wide rim, shown in both a direct view (from above) and a side profile (from the side) in pencil on a sepia-tinted background. The upper direct view features a large circular well in the center with meticulous shading suggesting depth, surrounded by a broad flat rim. There is an inscription in a cursive script along the inside upper arc of the rim, and a smaller circular emblem or seal at the center bottom of the rim, enclosing imagery and the numbers "1544", "13", and some indecipherable text around a stylized figure. Four small dots, likely decorative fastenings or design elements, are positioned symmetrically around the rim. Below the direct view, the side profile outlines the shallow concave shape of the vessel and the pronounced flatness and extension of the rim. The entire composition is rendered in shades of gray and black pencil, and the background has a faint rectangular border framing the drawing. The artist’s name, "M. FENGA," is written in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Baptismal Basin
